lastResponse.text: Most important number: nine one one if anyone is in immediate danger right now. If it’s not an emergency, call two one one next to reach a live specialist quickly. If this call drops, dial one of those first based on safety.
originalTexts: Most important number: **911** if anyone is in immediate danger right now. If it’s not an emergency, call **211** next to reach a live specialist quickly. If this call drops, dial one of those first based on safety.
